ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First look at the image: Figure 8 is a schematic diagram of the west coast region of South America. The Pacific Ocean is on the left, the Andes Mountains area is on the right, and four candidate locations a, b, c, and d are marked in the figure, with contour lines. It can be seen that point b is located in the inland area of northern Chile, in the high-altitude area near the Andes Mountains, and is relatively far from the coast. Then reason: the site selection for the world's largest astronomical telescope usually should meet conditions such as high altitude, thin and dry air, little cloud and fog, and little light pollution. Comparing several locations, a is closer to the coast and is more affected by sea fog; while b is located in a high-altitude inland arid area and better meets the requirements for an astronomical observatory site, so the best site selection is near location b.

raw_record.original_question:
根据图8，欧洲南方天文台拟建天文台并安装世界最大的天文望远镜，其最佳选址在哪里？

<image1>
raw_record.final_cot:
First look at the image: Figure 8 is a schematic diagram of the west coast region of South America. The Pacific Ocean is on the left, the Andes Mountains area is on the right, and four candidate locations a, b, c, and d are marked in the figure, with contour lines. It can be seen that point b is located in the inland area of northern Chile, in the high-altitude area near the Andes Mountains, and is relatively far from the coast.
Then reason: the site selection for the world's largest astronomical telescope usually should meet conditions such as high altitude, thin and dry air, little cloud and fog, and little light pollution. Comparing several locations, a is closer to the coast and is more affected by sea fog; while b is located in a high-altitude inland arid area and better meets the requirements for an astronomical observatory site, so the best site selection is near location b.
